The following types of schemes are J-2.
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> Any scheme locally of finite type over a field.
<STRUCT_0003> Any scheme locally of finite type over a Noetherian complete local ring.
<STRUCT_0004> Any scheme locally of finite type over <MATH_0001>.
<STRUCT_0005> Any scheme locally of finite type over a Noetherian local ring
of dimension <MATH_0002>.
<STRUCT_0006> Any scheme locally of finite type over a Nagata ring of dimension <MATH_0003>.
<STRUCT_0007> Any scheme locally of finite type over a Dedekind ring of
characteristic zero.
<STRUCT_0008> And so on.
<STRUCT_0009>

By Lemma <REF_0001> we only need to show that
the rings mentioned above are J-2. For this see
More on Algebra, Proposition <REF_0002>.
